available_substrate.reason: The available Codex process shares the controller host, readable controller checkout, process state, and caches. No disposable-runner coordinator or credential broker is configured in tracked repository state.

requirements.evidence: No runner coordinator or runner-provider configuration exists in tracked repository state.
The frozen scheduler emitted 12 separate one-arm bundles, but no real runner received one.
Controller bundle audits passed; no actual multi-runner substrate exists for the adversarial sentinel test.
The only available execution process runs on the controller host where the checkout is readable.
Hidden tests are absent from generated bundles, but end-to-end runner isolation was not demonstrated.
Human patches and Git remotes/future history are absent from generated bundles, but the available host can read the controller fixture tree.
No authenticated broker that withholds model/API credentials from agent commands is configured.
The available process shares host process and cache state; fresh-runner isolation cannot be asserted.
The controller has a separate evaluate-arm command, but no arm terminated and no evaluator ran.
The worker can capture raw events locally, but no private artifact sink or sanitized return channel is configured.
The worker parses token usage events, but no brokered control or treatment model call was allowed.

canary.reason: There is no actual compliant disposable substrate on which a canary result would be probative. Running it in the controller process would itself violate the preregistered isolation boundary.

stop_action: Stop before every benchmark arm and do not run hidden evaluation.
